headline:
Cheap for a reason,
growth has stalled
chart_note: 10-day range: $44.88 - $48.66, down almost 12% over the past month after a mid-window peak.
why_today: Down 1.4% today, continuing a month-long slide as GLP-1 competition weighs on growth expectations.
pro_1: Trades at just 11x trailing earnings with a 3.9% dividend yield - cheap relative to its own history
pro_2: Very low beta (0.35) - historically one of the more defensive large-cap healthcare names
con_1: Quarterly earnings actually fell 21% YoY - the cheap valuation reflects real growth concerns, not just sentiment
con_2: Analyst sentiment is mostly neutral (10 Hold vs. 4 Buy, 0 Strong Buy) - no strong conviction either way
